newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria to fill repo bids Thursday due to holiday.
newsitem.headline: Austria to fill repo bids Thursday due to holiday.

text.p: Austria's central bank said on Wednesday it would call for bids on securities repurchase agreements on Thursday, and fill them on the same day, one day ahead of its regular schedule, because of Friday's holiday.
The bank said it would call for repo bids at 0930 GMT and bids would have to be in by 1200 GMT.
Austrian financial markets will be closed on Friday for All Saints Day.
Last week, the National Bank allotted 5.83 billion schillings, or seven percent of bids, in one-week repos at an unchanged three percent.
